title: Function Blocks with Memory -- a Reusable Motor Starter
concept:
A FUNCTION returns a value and forgets everything. A FUNCTION_BLOCK keeps its
own MEMORY between scans (an instance) -- so you can write control logic ONCE
and drop an instance on every motor. The seal-in is the perfect example,
because it reads its own previous output:

    FUNCTION_BLOCK MotorStarter
    VAR_INPUT  Start : BOOL; Stop : BOOL; OL : BOOL; END_VAR
    VAR_OUTPUT Run : BOOL; END_VAR
        Run := (Start OR Run) AND Stop AND OL;   (* Run is the FB's memory *)
    END_FUNCTION_BLOCK

You then declare an instance and call it:  M1(Start:=..., Stop:=..., OL:=...);
and read M1.Run. Each instance remembers its own Run.
ab_note: Studio 5000 packages reusable logic as an Add-On Instruction (AOI); its state lives in the AOI's own tag -- exactly like an FB instance.
siemens_note: TIA Portal FB needs an instance data block (one per motor); the DB holds Run across scans. That instance memory is what makes the seal-in work.
task:
Write a FUNCTION_BLOCK named MotorStarter with:
  VAR_INPUT  Start, Stop, OL : BOOL
  VAR_OUTPUT Run : BOOL
Its body implements the 3-wire seal-in:  Run := (Start OR Run) AND Stop AND OL;
(Stop and OL are N.C. -- TRUE when safe -- so AND them in as-is.)

checks.message: Executed as a stateful instance: latches, holds, drops
checks.hint: The FB's Run output must persist between calls (that's the instance memory).

solution:
(* Lesson 14 -- Function Blocks with Memory: a Reusable Motor Starter *)
(* Wiring key:  N.O. contact -> read AS-IS (XIC)   |   N.C. contact -> AS-IS, fail-safe (XIC)   |   NOT x = XIO *)

FUNCTION_BLOCK MotorStarter
VAR_INPUT
    Start : BOOL;   (* N.O. start    -> XIC (as-is)            *)
    Stop  : BOOL;   (* N.C. stop     -> XIC (as-is, fail-safe) *)
    OL    : BOOL;   (* N.C. overload -> XIC (as-is)            *)
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Run : BOOL;     (* sealed-in run output (keeps its state)  *)
END_VAR
(* ----- YOUR LOGIC : write your answer between these two lines ----- *)
    Run := (Start OR Run) AND Stop AND OL;
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
